description.zh:
指标对应的维度。
* dataType 数据类型
* productType  产品类型
* instanceId 实例ID
* instanceName 实例名称
* instanceType 实例类型
description.en:
The dimensions of the metric that you want to query. Valid values:

*   dataType: data type
*   productType: product type
*   instanceId: instance ID
*   instanceName: instance name
*   instanceType: instance type

description.zh: 结束时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 数据片的时间间隔，单位为秒，最小值为3600。
description.en:
The time interval between data slices. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 3600.

Valid values:

*   3600: 1 hour
*   86400: 1 day
The measures of the metric that you want to query.
The name of the metric. Valid value: USAGEFEE.STAT.

description.zh:
排序标准。取值：

- `ASC`：升序。
- `DESC`：降序。
description.en:
The order in which data is sorted. Valid value:

*   `ASC`: ascending order
*   `DESC`: descending order

The dimension by which data is sorted.

Valid value:

*   dataType

description.zh:
查询的数据返回类型：
* instantQuery 非时序
* timeSeriesQuery 时序
description.en:
The data type. Valid values:

*   instantQuery: non-time series
*   timeSeriesQuery: time series

description.zh: 起始时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒。
description.en: The start of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms query-commercial-usage --interval-in-sec 3600 --start-time 1699200000000 --end-time 1699286400000 --order-by dataType --metric USAGEFEE.STAT --order ASC --advanced-filters Value=cn-hangzhou OpType=eq Key=regionId --dimensions dataType --measures byte_sum --query-type instantQuery --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
